messages:
sam: After upgrading redwoodctl via brew my localtest started using the wrong profile/token. redwoodctl local-serve spawned an auth daemon and then the device flow kept retrying forever — anyone seen the installer flip profiles on upgrade?

maria: oh no. do you have XDG_CONFIG_HOME set or multiple profiles? can you paste `redwoodctl config list` output?

sam: pasted below — looks like installer created a new profile called 'local' and made it active, but i always used 'default'.

sam: ```
$ redwoodctl config list
profiles:
 - default (path: ~/.config/redwood/profiles/default)
 - local (path: ~/.config/redwood/profiles/local)
active: local
```

eli: that sounds like the profile-merge logic ran and selected the wrong candidate. did you `brew upgrade redwoodctl` or install another way?

sam: brew upgrade. also when i run `redwoodctl local-serve --port 5252` the device flow keeps failing with connection retries (port looks free but auth never finishes).

eli: two practical workarounds: (1) export REDWOOD_PROFILE=default before starting local-serve, (2) run `redwoodctl login --device --port 0` to force an ephemeral callback port if something is conflicting.

leo: confirming this is a bug — installer should preserve the existing active profile. filing an issue and scheduling a hotfix. linking: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/issues/842

ci-bot: Released candidate 1.4.3-rc (profile-merge-fix branch). Running smoke tests now.

maria: @sam if you can dm me `~/.config/redwood/installer.log` and the exact brew command you used that would help repro.

sam: sending logs in DM. one more odd thing: i saw a file `~/.config/redwood/.last_install_profile` with 'local' in it. maybe installer writes that during postinstall.

eli: thanks — that file shouldn't override an existing `active` field. we'll make the hotfix prefer an existing active profile and only create a new one if none exist. also adding better error when device flow port is in use.

maria: temporary note for docs: add `REDWOOD_PROFILE` and `--port 0` tips to the local testing quickstart.

sam: workaround works, thanks! :thumbsup:

eli: follow-up plan: hotfix today, patch release with tests to preserve profile on upgrade, and a CLI flag `--profile` for local-serve so this doesn't rely on envs. will update issue when merged.

maria: updating the onboarding checklist to mention the env var workaround until patch lands. closing loop after hotfix is published.
